string.name: what_s_new_toast
string.font:
- Bug fixes and performance improvements. 
 - Upgraded target SDK to 37 for enhanced performance and security. 
 - Updated core dependencies, Kotlin, and build environment for improved stability. 
 - Refined build configuration and optimized player performance.

item.font:
Bug fixes and performance improvements. 
 Removed features apps in-app ads popup. 
 We've enhanced the functionality of the app. 
 We're utilizing the new, advanced NowPlaying API for real-time updates regarding playback metadata state. 
 We've added a new Dynamic Widget that automatically adjusts to size. 
 More App Widget styles are coming soon.
